questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Corona affected my opportunities, why a chose a nordic country. Apart from that it was important to me, that there where nice courses available and that the destination could give me nice experiences.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: I think it was okay. However, I thougth that there many things to fill out, which could be a bit overwhelming and confusing.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: I was at a meeting at the faculty, where I met some other students and got a bit information about the university. Apart from that, I haven't received any assistance. However, it would have been nice with some arranged social gaterings in the beginning of the semester, which i now other students had.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer:
It was okay, but it is expensive. Me and my roomate found it on
finn.no

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: That it is more expensive and it is nice to have roomates.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: I for sure do not remember all of it. But I did most of the registration from home. It was a bit confusing signing up for the different courses, but then i just contacted the university and they helped me out.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: I contacted Ola from the university and the course leaders.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I got the classes that i wanted, except one class which got cancelled this semester.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Just contact the university if your are confused or in doubt, they are very helpfull.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: I think the level of the courses was fine. Some of them was the same level as back home, and some of them a bit easier, but I think it also depends on earlier experience with the topic.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: I think the teaching style was quite similar. However, I had to oral class presentations as examns, which was different from what I'm used to - but it was nice.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
HMAN4210: Leadership, management and organizational development 
HELSEF4405 22V Kjønn, kropp og medikalisering
HELSEF4511 22V Digitalisering, samhandling og innovasjon
INTHE4113 22V Introduction to Medical Anthropology: key concepts and perspectives 
PSY4116 22V Sentrale temaer i anvendt helsepsykologi

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: I would recommend: HMAN4210, HELSEF4405 and INTHE4113.

What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: I didn't really had any unexpected costs. However, I was supriced of the amount of books you have to buy, but I didn't buy all of them.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Books and electricity.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: There where sports clubs and other social clubs. There where also a course in cross country skiing which was really nice.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: The cross country skiing course.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: I would definately recommend students to explore the nature and to travel around in Norway. Especially wildcamping is very accessible and you can rent or loan a lot of equipment for free at the university or at BUA of FRIGO.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Very easy.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Not really. I think you just have to be very open and join events especially in the beginning even though it seems a bit overwhelming.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Norway is very similar to Denmark.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: I appreciate the very sporty and outdoorsy culture.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Use FRIGO and BUA to rent and loan stuff for going skiing and wild camping. And buy your greens in the area called Grønland - it is much cheaper.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Not really.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: It has been very nice to have time to focus on your studies and also have time to be yourself and do stuff that you may not have time to do in your everyday life back home.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: The challenge is to get new friends and be away from you people at home. But it is a nice experience and also something you learn a lot from.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
